stdout:
Build kit for "plus checklist group"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `work-item-detail` only loosely, so start from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Top Nav
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        table-collapsible
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Collapsible Table
description: Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns - for groups that do not share a schema, where one table would stand full of empty cells. One time range drives them all, and rows expand into a history chart. Accounts, integrations, sections, sort, expand, or collapse.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-collapsible --type page <path>

name:        table-grouped
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Grouped Table
description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-grouped --type page <path>

SEARCH MATCHES
Page templates keyword search matched, best first.

name:        work-item-detail
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      template
displayName: Work Item Detail
score:       72
reason:      matches 2/3 terms: plus, checklist
description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items. The shape for any tracked item with children, properties, and a comment history - a task, ticket, issue, story, bug, card, request, or work item.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template work-item-detail --type page --skeleton
